cases.copilotQuestion: 按项目和账期汇总月对账折后实收金额

copilotQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(v."projectId" AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", v."业务月份" AS "accountPeriod", 'rent-settlement' AS "chain", 'discounted-receivable' AS "metricId", SUM(v."折后实收") AS "amount" FROM public.xycyl_ads_finance_month_settlement v WHERE v."业务月份" LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY CAST(v."projectId" AS VARCHAR), v."业务月份" ORDER BY 1, 2

applicationMysqlQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(m.project_id AS CHAR) AS projectId, CASE WHEN m.settlement_year IS NOT NULL AND m.settlement_month IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS CHAR), '-', LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS CHAR), 2, '0')) WHEN m.year_and_month REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(m.year_and_month, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(m.year_and_month, 5, 2)) ELSE m.year_and_month END AS accountPeriod, 'rent-settlement' AS chain, 'discounted-receivable' AS metricId, ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(m.folding_after_total_amount AS CHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 2) AS amount FROM a_month_accounting m WHERE m.status > 1 AND (m.settlement_year = 2026 OR ((m.settlement_year IS NULL OR m.settlement_month IS NULL) AND m.year_and_month IS NOT NULL AND CAST(SUBSTRING(m.year_and_month, 1, 4) AS UNSIGNED) = 2026)) GROUP BY CAST(m.project_id AS CHAR), CASE WHEN m.settlement_year IS NOT NULL AND m.settlement_month IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS CHAR), '-', LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS CHAR), 2, '0')) WHEN m.year_and_month REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(m.year_and_month, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(m.year_and_month, 5, 2)) ELSE m.year_and_month END ORDER BY projectId, accountPeriod

cases.notes: F2 proof case: ADS month-settlement discounted receivable must tie out to direct application MySQL a_month_accounting by project and accounting period.

cases.copilotQuestion: 按项目和账期汇总售账应收金额

copilotQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(v."projectId" AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", v."业务月份" AS "accountPeriod", 'sale-gift-bad-debt' AS "chain", 'sale-receivable' AS "metricId", SUM(v."应收金额") AS "amount" FROM public.xycyl_ads_sale_account_summary v WHERE v."业务月份" LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY CAST(v."projectId" AS VARCHAR), v."业务月份" ORDER BY 1, 2

applicationMysqlQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(b.project_id AS CHAR) AS projectId, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(b.code, 2, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(b.code, 6, 2)) AS accountPeriod, 'sale-gift-bad-debt' AS chain, 'sale-receivable' AS metricId, ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(a.receivable_amount AS CHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 2) AS amount FROM a_sale_account a JOIN t_flower_biz_info b ON a.biz_id = b.id WHERE b.code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(b.code) >= 7 AND SUBSTRING(b.code, 2, 6) REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' AND SUBSTRING(b.code, 2, 4) = '2026' AND b.biz_type IN (5, 6, 7) GROUP BY CAST(b.project_id AS CHAR), CONCAT(SUBSTRING(b.code, 2, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(b.code, 6, 2)) ORDER BY projectId, accountPeriod

cases.notes: F2 proof case: ADS sale-account receivable must tie out to direct application MySQL a_sale_account joined to t_flower_biz_info. Account period follows SaleMonthlyReportMapper code-month caliber.

copilotQuery.nativeSql: SELECT v."会计月份" AS "accountPeriod", 'voucher-ledger' AS "chain", 'voucher-count' AS "metricId", SUM(v."凭证数") AS "amount" FROM public.xycyl_ads_finance_voucher_monthly v WHERE v."会计月份" LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY v."会计月份" ORDER BY v."会计月份"

applicationMysqlQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CASE WHEN v.account_priod REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN v.account_priod WHEN v.account_priod REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(v.account_priod, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(v.account_priod, 5, 2)) ELSE v.account_priod END AS accountPeriod, 'voucher-ledger' AS chain, 'voucher-count' AS metricId, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS amount FROM f_voucher v WHERE CASE WHEN v.account_priod REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN v.account_priod WHEN v.account_priod REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(v.account_priod, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(v.account_priod, 5, 2)) ELSE v.account_priod END LIKE '2026-%' AND v.code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN v.account_priod REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN v.account_priod WHEN v.account_priod REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(v.account_priod, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(v.account_priod, 5, 2)) ELSE v.account_priod END ORDER BY accountPeriod

cases.notes: F2/F4 proof case: NL2SQL ADS voucher count must tie out to direct application MySQL voucher header count by account period. SQL intentionally uses application table names, not ODS or Trino catalog names.
